title: CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow an infinite loop on a short request body when… (CVE-2026-120651)
description: CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl contain a vulnerability where an infinite loop can occur on processing a short request body if $DISABLE_UPLOADS is set. This happens because the code reads until the Content-Length bytes have arrived, but if the actual body is shorter, the read returns 0 repeatedly, causing the loop to never end. This allows a client to keep a server process busy indefinitely with a crafted request.
